what_happened: Scene layout/style 10: single black basin, tall cylindrical faucet stem with a horizontal spout arm and a side lever handle (same faucet as s15, s29). Stage 0: the gripper reached the lever at ~86 (touch 86-171), closed fully at 116 (width 0.002) and pushed the lever up with the closed fingers: handle joint 0.06 (112), 0.22 (128), 0.35 (176). At ~176-184 it backed off (wrist view swings to the tile wall) leaving the handle at 0.346 rad, just under the 0.40 water-on threshold (every success pushes it to the 0.50 stop). No water stream is visible at any point. The policy then behaved as if the water were on: 250-272 it pushed the spout to +0.36 (still 'centre'), hovered under/around the faucet 300-550, came back to the lever area at ~600-700 (closes at 612 and 685, lever does not move) and 700-900 pushed the spout right to +0.64..+1.09 with the water still off. Handle stayed at 0.346 to the end.
causal_chain: closed-finger push on the lever 112-176 stopped at 0.346 rad (< 0.40 water-on; successes go to 0.50) -> no water -> policy moved on to the spout (250-272, 700-900) as if stage 0 were done -> later visits to the lever (612, 685) did not move it -> stage 0 never complete, timeout 900
self_recovery: Returned to the lever region at ~600-700 and ~860 (wrist sees the lever with the red dot; closes at 612, 685) but the handle never moved beyond 0.346. Not successful.
official_criterion_notes: Criterion agrees with the video: no water stream is rendered at 0.346 rad. A 0.054 rad near-miss on the water-on threshold.

packet_facts: stage0 never complete; state_end handle_joint 0.346, water_on false
spout (saved states) +0.36@272, +0.64@704, +1.09@864 with water off; washed_loc all false

uncertain_about: Whether the fingers slipped off the lever or the policy simply stopped pushing at 176; the wrist view shows the lever partly rotated and the gripper withdrawing, without a visible slip.
